question: Why are radio and television termed as mass media?

options: A) Because they are exclusively used for internet browsing and satellite tracking
B) Because they help to relay news, pictures, and telephone calls to vast audiences around the world
C) Because they have completely replaced newspapers and personal communication
D) Because they are managed and supervised only by government corporations

question_hi: रेडियो और टेलीविज़न को जनसंचार माध्यम (मास मीडिया) क्यों कहा जाता है?

B) क्योंकि वे दुनिया भर में विशाल दर्शकों तक समाचार, चित्र और टेलीफोन कॉल पहुँचाने में मदद करते हैं

question:
Consider the following statements regarding the location of recreational and entertainment services:
1. Multiplexes and restaurants might find location within or near the Central Business District (CBD).
2. A golf course chooses a site where land costs are higher than in the CBD.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: Statement 1 is correct because multiplexes and restaurants might find location within or near the CBD. Statement 2 is incorrect because a golf course would choose a site where land costs are lower than in the CBD, not higher.
question_hi:

1. मल्टीप्लेक्स और रेस्तरां केंद्रीय व्यापार जिला (CBD) के भीतर या उसके पास स्थान पा सकते हैं।
2. एक गोल्फ कोर्स ऐसी साइट चुनता है जहाँ भूमि की लागत CBD की तुलना में अधिक होती है।
